title: Yellowed Velvety American Lamb Stew
description: A winey and velvety American lamb stew featuring ras el hanout, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this dish is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the ras el hanout, thyme, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine, beef broth, and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Add the carrots and potatoes, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the stew from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
